channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Euro dips further as grim German data adds to political uncertainty and debt issues
item.description: The Euro (EUR) keeps heading lower against a firmer US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, as growing political uncertainty and a deteriorating fiscal outlook have renewed fears of debt contagion in the region.

item.title: Brent: Prices hold near $100 as Gulf risks persist – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that ICE Brent is still finding support around the $100/bbl level as geopolitical risks in the Persian Gulf outweigh an improving supply backdrop. They highlight recent attacks on Saudi infrastructure, adjustments in Kuwait and Saudi output and pricing, and lingering vulnerability in European natural gas storage ahead of winter.

item.title: BoJ’s Ueda: Japan's economy recovering moderately albeit with some weaknesses
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Tuesday that the Japanese economy is recovering moderately albeit with some weaknesses. Ueda added that price trend is approaching 2%.

item.title: Euro: Downtrend slows but further lows possible against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note that EUR/USD briefly broke below 1.1180 to a 17‑month low before rebounding to close around 1.1220. Intraday, they expect consolidation inside a defined range.

item.title: Canadian Dollar softens as oil prices fall
item.description: The USD/CAD pair gathers strength to near 1.4275 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. Falling crude oil prices drag the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) lower against the US Dollar (USD). Canada’s Ivey Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) data is due later on Tuesday.

item.title: Indian Rupee faces pressure from higher bond yields, FIIs outflow
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday due to the continuous surge in global bond yields. The USD/INR pair rises to near 96.43, the highest level seen in over two months.

item.title: -10.6%: Germany’s Factory Orders fall in August, missed -1.0% estimates
item.description: Germany's Factory Orders dropped in August, suggesting that the country’s manufacturing sector activity lost momentum, according to the official data published by the Federal Statistics Office on Tuesday.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Bulls seem hesitant near $89.00 amid easing supply risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – edges higher during the Asian session on Tuesday, reclaiming the $89.00 mark and snapping a two-day winning streak. The black liquid, however, remains close to a four-week low, touched last Friday, amid mixed fundamental cues.

item.title: Gold hits two-month low as bears await break below $4,100 amid sustained USD strength
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts fresh sellers following the previous day's consolidative price move and drops to a two-month low during the Asian session on Tuesday, with bears now awaiting a break below the $4,100 mark before positioning for further losses.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Strengthens above 110.00, while bearish technical bias persists
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory near 110.20 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. Traders await the speech from the Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda later on Tuesday for more clues on the interest rate outlook.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Tests 177.50 after rebounding from descending channel bottom
item.description: EUR/JPY halts its seven-day losing streak, trading around 177.40 during Asian hours on Tuesday. Technical analysis of the daily chart shows that the currency cross is remaining close to the lower boundary of the descending channel, suggesting the price holds support and a temporary bounce.

item.title: BoJ may indicate underlying inflation is near the 2% target, sources say
item.description: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) could indicate later this month that underlying inflation has reached nearly its 2% target, according to three sources familiar with the central bank’s thinking. Such a signal would underscore the BoJ’s willingness to resume raising interest rates in the coming months.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds above 102, remains supported by firm bond yields
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) trades broadly firm against its major currency peers as United States (US) bond yields remain higher due to persistent inflation fears.

item.title: Japanese Yen steadies amid expansionary fiscal plans, rate hike uncertainty
item.description: USD/JPY moves little after posting minor gains in the previous day, trading around 157.90 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The currency pair has steadied into a tight trading range following recent developments in Japanese fiscal policy.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar consolidates around 0.5600, near YTD low as USD stays bullish
item.description: The NZD/USD pair seesaws between tepid gains and minor losses during the Asian session on Tuesday, trading around the 0.5600 mark, just above its lowest level since November 2025, touched the previous day.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $60.50 as US Treasury yields rise
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) pares its recent gains from the previous day, trading around $60.70 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Tuesday. Silver remains locked near two-month lows as a resilient US Dollar (USD) and surging Treasury yields continue to overshadow supportive economic drivers.

item.title: Euro weakens below 1.1250 on France debt concerns
item.description: The EUR/USD pair declined to around 1.1220 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The Euro (EUR) weakens near a 17-month low against the US Dollar (USD amid growing concern over France’s debt position.

item.title: British Pound extends range play; holds above 1.3200 as bullish USD caps upside
item.description: The GBP/USD pair extends its consolidative move during the Asian session on Tuesday, trading above the 1.3200 mark and within a familiar range held over the past two weeks or so.

item.title: Australian Dollar holds steady amid soft consumer sentiment
item.description: AUD/USD remains steady after two days of gains, trading around 0.6970 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The currency pair is hovering in a tight range as the Australian Dollar (AUD) finds support despite local economic headwinds.

item.title: Canadian Dollar seems vulnerable near April 2025 lows amid weak oil prices, bullish USD
item.description: The USD/CAD pair attracts some dip-buyers during the Asian session on Tuesday, stalling the previous day's modest pullback from the vicinity of the 1.4300 mark, or its highest level since April 2025.

item.title: WTI falls to near $88.50 on G7 reserve release
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $88.60 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. WTI faces some selling pressure as rising Middle East crude exports and a release of oil stocks by the Group of Seven nations boost supplies.

item.title: US President Donald Trump signs order to ease limits on diesel variety to curb costs
item.description: US President Donald Trump signed an executive order to ease restrictions on the use of a tax-exempt variety of diesel, Bloomberg reported on Monday.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis claim missile, drone strikes on multiple targets in Saudi Arabia
item.description: Yemen's Houthi group said on Monday that it carried out three military operations using ballistic and cruise missiles and drones against airports, an oil facility, and military sites across Saudi Arabia, Xinhua News Agency reported.

item.title: The Japanese Yen firms on a BoJ speech about AI and gives it all back
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Ueda speaks on Tuesday at 06:35 GMT, and his first major remarks since the September 18 hike to 1.25% are the next test of October hike bets. Traders give a second hike on October 30 about a one-in-four chance.

item.title: Gold holds steady below $4,150 amid elevated US yields
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) trades on a flat note near $4,140 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. Pressure from a stronger US Dollar (USD) and elevated US Treasury yields was offset by reduced expectations of a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike this month.

item.title: Australian Dollar defies rising yields as AUD/USD closes in on 0.70
item.description: The Aussie Dollar registers back-to-back days of gains on Monday, even though US Treasury yields edged higher, underpinning the US Dollar, which appreciated against a basket of six currencies but not versus the Australian Dollar. The AUD/USD trades at 0.6972, up 0.37%.

item.title: The New Zealand Dollar holds near its lows while business confidence jumps
item.description: New Zealand's firms are more upbeat and raising fewer prices, and the second half of that matters more for the Kiwi. NZD/USD trades just above 0.5600 after a fresh low beneath it, back near its November 2025 low.

item.title: US Treasury yields scale multi-year highs as inflation fears return
item.description: US Treasury yields edged up at the beginning of the week, with the 30- and 10-year yields reaching multi-year highs as inflation expectations rose, as shown in a US Institute for Supply Management (ISM) survey indicating that business activity in the services sector slowed while input prices surged.

item.title: The Euro breaks to a fresh low, then bounces, as Spain calls a snap vote
item.description: Reports that Spain's government was preparing an early election pushed EUR/USD to its lowest since May 2025, and hedge-fund selling in Asia set off option barriers that deepened the fall, traders said. The pair has since recovered more than half of that drop and trades back above 1.1200.
